claims: League of Legends is a free-to-play 5v5 MOBA.
MOBA stands for Multiplayer Online Battle Arena.
League of Legends was developed by Riot Games.
In League of Legends, teams work to destroy the enemy Nexus.
League of Legends is primarily played on PC (Windows/macOS).
League of Legends features over 140 champions.
League of Legends includes a map called Summoner's Rift.
In League of Legends, two teams of five players control unique champions with special abilities.
League of Legends is available on PC (Windows and macOS).
League of Legends has over 140 champions, each with unique abilities and playstyles.
Champions in League of Legends are broadly classified into Tanks, Mages, Marksmen, Assassins, Fighters, and Supports.
League of Legends has roles like Top, Jungle, Mid, Bot (ADC), or Support.
Minimum OS requirement for League of Legends is Windows 7/8/10/11 or macOS 10.12+.
Minimum processor requirement for League of Legends is Intel Core i3-530 or AMD A6-3650.
Minimum memory requirement for League of Legends is 2 GB RAM.
Minimum graphics requirement for League of Legends is NVidia GeForce 9600GT or AMD HD 6570.
Minimum storage requirement for League of Legends is 16 GB+ HD space.
League of Legends has a championship called LoL First Stand 2026.
